en.name: SDT 275
en.description: Ideal for the cutting operations of bars, profiles and steel reinforcements for PVC windows

STANDARD ACCESSORIES: Equipped with saw blade Ø275 mm
GENERAL FEATURES: Pivoting range 45° to the right and 45° to the left
Possibility to select the motor speed according to the material
Ideal for the cutting of reinforcements steels used for PVC Windows
Cutting capacity: 70 x 70 mm square profile
